method: Visual review of all 477 collected candidate rasters (including seven freshly fetched Philadelphia companion sheets); 423 approved city/resource/image SHA-256 entries. All 423 approved images passed the actual browser decoder and quality checks. Actual loadCity pipeline with deterministic random=0.5 and recorded public live API responses; no browser credentials. Counts are sampled playable pools, not entire collection totals.
